column3: NASB renders “for you” as “for the sake of you” and ends the verse with a dash.
NASB renders “administration” as “stewardship.”
NASB follows the critical text (passive “was made known”); “I have written before” is rendered “I wrote before.”
NASB adds “by referring to this” and renders “reading it” as “when you read.”
NASB follows the critical text without “in.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in Christ Jesus”); it adds “to be specific, that” and renders “joint-body” as “fellow members of the body.”
NASB follows the critical text (“I was made”); “servant” is rendered “minister.”
NASB follows the critical text; “unsearchable” is rendered “unfathomable.”
NASB follows the critical text without “through Jesus Christ”; “enlighten” is rendered “bring to light,” and “from the ages” is “for ages.”
NASB reorders the verse; “heavenly realms” is rendered “heavenly places.”
NASB adds “This was” and renders “purpose of the ages” as “eternal purpose” and “accomplished” as “carried out.”
NASB follows the critical text; “access in confidence” is rendered “confident access,” and “faith from Him” is “faith in Him.”
NASB renders “implore” as “ask you” and “which is your glory” as “for they are your glory.”
NASB follows the critical text without “of our Lord Jesus Christ.”
NASB renders “is named” as “derives its name.”
NASB follows the critical text; “give” is rendered “grant,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB restructures the verse; “founded” is rendered “grounded.”
NASB renders “be fully able to grasp” as “be able to comprehend.”
NASB renders “unto” as “up to.”
NASB renders “super overexcessively” as “exceeding abundantly.”
NASB follows the critical text (“and”); “the age of the ages” is rendered “forever and ever.”
